claims.text: Most bleeding stops spontaneously; about 25% need endoscopic hemostasis (clip, ethanol or epinephrine injection, or electrocautery)
claims.quote: Most episodes of bleeding stop spontaneously; approximately 25% of patients require endoscopic hemostasis (by clip placement, injection of ethanol or epinephrine, or by electrocautery) (1, 2).

claims.text: Intra-arterial vasopressin (or embolization) into the left gastric artery during angiography may also control bleeding
claims.quote: Intra-arterial infusion of vasopressin or therapeutic embolization into the left gastric artery during angiography may also be used to control bleeding.
